g.text: Frontier models rarely invent cases. They misquote real ones.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Bare models, no tools. Top bar: citations that resolve to no case. Bottom bar: wrong names and quotes not in the opinion,

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: per citation. 150 questions each (Flash models 60 or 40). Preliminary, Sept 22 2026.
